issues.where: the glass and base from 21.60 s through 23.10 s
issues.what: the globe never lifts, strokes, reverses, or tilts; the outline stays locked while the interior storms, so it has no weight in the hand
issues.fix: drive unequal strokes with a lagging tilt, a lift that costs effort, and a set-down that lands and settles

issues.where: the swap from 23.10 s to 23.53 s, including the dark frame at 23.33 s
issues.what: base, petals, sand, background lights, and particle color pop in one step; no clean frame is half one season and half another
issues.fix: grow the new season through the storm so the base changes only where the eye cannot catch a jump

issues.where: the liquid inside the glass during the shake, 21.60 s to 23.10 s
issues.what: the petals whip into a storm while the glass is still, so nothing lags the glass, slams, or folds off a reversal
issues.fix: hold the liquid back on each stroke, then let it slam, fold into one whirl, and die away after the landing
